title: H-GLow: Accelerating Graph Generation via Hazard-Guided Discrete Flow Matching
abstract: arXiv:2610.33599v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Discrete flow matching (DFM) offers a promising approach to graph generation; however, generating high-quality graphs with few steps remains challenging due to the strong dependencies between nodes and edges. Although DFM decouples training from sampling, enabling flexible sampling strategies without retraining, existing graph DFM samplers often rely on task-specific heuristics, substantially expanding the hyperparameter space. Moreover, graph DFM models still require sampling budgets comparable to those of diffusion-based approaches, leaving their potential for accelerating graph generation only partially realized. In this work, we introduce H-Glow, a hazard-guided framework for accelerating graph generation built on the decomposition of Continuous-Time Markov chain (CTMC) generators into hazards and conditional jump distributions. translated_title: H-GLow：基于风险引导的离散流匹配加速图生成
translated_abstract: 离散流匹配为图生成提供了一种有前景的方法；然而，由于节点与边之间存在强依赖关系，如何用更少的步骤生成高质量图仍然具有挑战性。尽管DFM将训练与采样解耦，使得无需重新训练即可采用灵活的采样策略，但现有的图DFM采样器通常依赖于特定任务的启发式方法，从而显著扩展了超参数空间。此外，图DFM模型仍然需要与基于扩散的方法相当的采样预算，使其在加速图生成方面的潜力仅得到部分实现。在这项工作中，我们提出了H-Glow，一个用于加速图生成的风险引导框架，其建立在将连续时间马尔可夫链（CTMC）生成元分解为风险与条件跳跃分布的基础上。H-Glow利用这些量来规划图编辑，并动态调整采样时间以适应图的……
tldr: 提出H-Glow框架，通过将连续时间马尔可夫链生成元分解为风险与条件跳跃分布，据此规划图编辑并动态调整采样时间，从而以更少的采样步数加速生成高质量图。
en_tdlr: H-Glow accelerates graph generation in fewer sampling steps by decomposing CTMC generators into hazards and conditional jump distributions, which are used to plan graph edits and dynamically adjust the sampling time.
